## How it was checked

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes, or the change does not touch the interface
- [ ] New or changed functional-group rules have positive and negative test molecules
- [ ] New or changed notes cite open sources, are in our own words and contain no clinical advice
- [ ] Interface changes checked in light and dark, on a phone, with the keyboard
